structured_output.scope_summary: This revision of EIP-4844 adds blob-carrying transactions. They use EIP-2718 type 0x05 with an SSZ-encoded `SignedBlobTransaction`. Blocks carry the minimal encoding, while the network/mempool encoding wraps the transaction with blobs, KZG commitments and an aggregated KZG proof that the EL must verify. A separate data-gas fee market is added: a new `excess_data_gas` header field, `fake_exponential` pricing, a target of 2 and a maximum of 4 blobs per block, and a data fee that is burned before execution and not refunded. The EIP also adds a `DATAHASH` opcode (0x49, 3 gas) and a KZG point-evaluation precompile (0x14, 50000 gas). Blob persistence is delegated to the consensus layer as sidecars.
